name: Copperspire
description: An orange dwarf over red deserts and a living ocean world with twin moons. Copper salts tint the dunes while tides rule the seas. The spire settlements rise where the two economies meet.

stars.name: Copperspire Glow
stars.description: A steady orange dwarf with a calm middle age and generous temperate band. Its light flatters red rock and punishes pale stone. Settlers praise it in every charter preamble.

planets.name: Verdigris
planets.description: A dune sea where copper salts paint every erg green and teal. Deep wells sustain oasis towns strung along the equator. Storms can bury a crawler between one shift and the next.

planets.name: Spirefall
planets.description: A shallow sea world with basalt spires rising like drowned cathedrals. Two moons pull tides the sailors navigate by heart. Reef markets trade in shell, salt, and gossip.

moons.name: Tidemark
moons.description: A bright cratered moon ruling the stronger tide with total reliability. Tide mills on the coasts grind grain on its schedule. Its phases set every contract deadline.

moons.name: Slacktide
moons.description: A small dark moonlet tangling the tides into profitable complexity. Smugglers love the confused currents it makes. Customs hates them with equal passion.
